cues.text: Red rock arches rise from a turquoise sea.
High in the bright blue sky, the colony ship's landing craft descends on a trail of light.
It slips behind the distant cliffs. Green bushes cling to the rocky islands.
A flock of birds circles the arches above the gently rippling water.

beats.note: Turquoise water, red rock formations with natural arches, green vegetation. Blue sky with fluffy white clouds.
A bright streak of light from a landing craft descends in the sky on the right.
The landing craft disappears behind the tall rocks.
Birds fly near the arches in the distance. The water ripples gently.
